nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the Ownable constructor and reassigned by transferOwnership.
Total token supply; set in the BCC constructor and reduced by burn.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn and the constructor.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Constant token name 'BOOTSYCOIN'.
Constant token symbol 'BCC'.
Constant token decimals value 18.
Constant initial supply of 1000000000 * 10**18.
Ownable constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender with no authorization check.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
Public ERC20 transfer that debits msg.sender and credits _to using SafeMath.sub/add.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Public transferFrom that spends the allowance of msg.sender and moves balances between _from and _to.
Public approve that overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Public function that adds _addedValue to the caller's allowance for _spender.
Public function that subtracts _subtractedValue from the caller's allowance for _spender.
Public burn that destroys _value tokens from msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
BCC constructor that sets totalSupply and credits the whole initial supply to msg.sender.
External caller address, used for ownership assignment and for indexing balance/allowance mappings.
State write owner = msg.sender performed in the constructor without any access control.
State write owner = newOwner performed after only an onlyOwner check.
Writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[_to] without reentrancy protection.
Writes balances[_from], balances[_to] and allowed[_from][msg.sender] using an unchecked allowance read.
Overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] with _value, exposing the classic approve race condition.
Reduces totalSupply and the caller balance by _value without reentrancy protection.
New owner address supplied by the caller of transferOwnership.
Recipient address of transfer.
Amount of tokens moved by transfer.
Address whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Debited address in transferFrom.
Credited address in transferFrom.
Amount of tokens moved and deducted from the allowance in transferFrom.
Spender address granted an allowance in approve.
Allowance value written for the spender in approve.
Token owner queried in allowance.
Spender queried in allowance.
Spender whose allowance is increased.
Amount added to the spender allowance.
Spender whose allowance is decreased.
Amount subtracted from the spender allowance.
Amount of tokens to burn.
Local cache of msg.sender inside burn.
Local cache of the previous allowance in decreaseApproval.
Local cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.

edges.reason: msg.sender silently becomes the contract owner in the Ownable constructor with no validation.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping written by transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in the transferFrom allowance write.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping overwritten by approve.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate transferOwnership.
burner local variable is assigned from msg.sender inside burn.
newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter is written directly into the owner state variable.
_to recipient flows into transfer.
_value amount flows into transfer.
_value is added and subtracted to balances during the transfer state writes.
_owner parameter is used to read balances in balanceOf.
_from address flows into transferFrom.
_to address flows into transferFrom.
_value amount flows into transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from balances and allowance in the transferFrom state writes.
_spender key flows into approve.
_value amount flows into approve.
_value is written into allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
_owner key is used in the allowance lookup.
_spender key is used in the allowance lookup.
_spender key flows into increaseApproval.
_addedValue is added to the allowance via SafeMath.add.
_spender key flows into decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue is compared and subtracted from the allowance.
_value amount flows into burn.
_value is subtracted from totalSupply and the burner balance.
burner local variable is used to update the balance inside burn.
oldValue caches allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before the decrease.
oldValue determines the branch and subtraction in decreaseApproval.
_allowance caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
_allowance is reduced and rewritten by transferFrom.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
The BCC constructor implicitly invokes the Ownable base constructor.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
Unsafe operation assigns the untrusted deployer address to owner.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state variable.
Unsafe operation writes newOwner into the owner state variable.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the balances mapping.
transferFrom mutates the allowed mapping.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval adds to the allowed mapping value.
decreaseApproval subtracts from the allowed mapping value.
burn reduces totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
burn reduces the caller balance in the balances mapping.
BCC constructor sets totalSupply to initialSupply.
BCC constructor credits initialSupply to msg.sender balances.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
Transfer state writes land in the balances mapping.
TransferFrom state writes land in the balances mapping.
Approve state write lands in the allowed mapping.
Burn state write lands in totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: Function parameter only meaningful inside transferOwnership; fold into the function node.
Recipient parameter is scoped to transfer only; merge into the function.
Amount parameter is scoped to transfer only; merge into the function.
Query parameter is scoped to balanceOf only; merge into the function.
Debit address parameter is scoped to transferFrom; merge into the function.
Credit address parameter is scoped to transferFrom; merge into the function.
Amount parameter drives the transferFrom state writes; merge into the function.
Spender parameter is scoped to approve only; merge into the function.
Allowance value parameter is scoped to approve only; merge into the function.
Query parameter is scoped to allowance only; merge into the function.
Query parameter is scoped to allowance only; merge into the function.
Spender parameter is scoped to increaseApproval; merge into the function.
Increment parameter is scoped to increaseApproval; merge into the function.
Spender parameter is scoped to decreaseApproval; merge into the function.
Decrement parameter is scoped to decreaseApproval; merge into the function.
Burn amount parameter is scoped to burn only; merge into the function.
Local cache of msg.sender is only used inside burn; merge into the function.
Local allowance cache is only used inside decreaseApproval; merge into the function.
Local allowance cache is only used inside transferFrom; merge into the function.
